## Overview

I passed the Google Analytics certification with a reported score of 88. My reflection connects GA4 concepts to practical customer engagement analysis.

The certification provides evidence of my foundational knowledge in GA4 reporting, implementation concepts, audiences, dimensions, events, and integrations.

## Strong Areas

- GA4 events, audiences, dimensions, and reports.
- Understanding user acquisition and traffic acquisition.
- Connecting measurement strategy to business goals.

## Growth Areas

- BigQuery exports and SQL-based analysis.
- Customizing reports and dimensions.
- Choosing the right exploration method for a question.

## Portfolio Connection

The certification supports one of my broader professional goals: using analytics platforms to understand user behavior, improve marketing performance, and guide data-driven customer engagement.

It also identifies the next learning path: deeper BigQuery export analysis, stronger report customization, and more confident selection between exploration methods such as free-form analysis and funnel analysis.
